name: Báinleannán
text: Báinleannán is a female spirit in the folk tales of Ireland told by word of mouth. She keeps company with heroes who set out on quests. She acts as a kind of fairy lover. Those tales compare her to the leannán sídhe. Oral tradition holds her close to questing figures.

attributes.attribute: accompanies questing heroes in Irish folk tales
belongs to the class of the fairy lover
appears in stories drawn from oral tradition

okr.objective: Lift Báinleannán from her role beside questers in the oral tales of the Irish.
key_results: names Báinleannán as a female spirit
